slides.title: Painters: when the property manager says your COI expired and the crew can't start, say exactly this:

slides.label: Say this
slides.title: "Give me 20 minutes. I'll have our agent send the current certificate straight to you."
slides.body: Not "it should be fine, we're covered."

slides.label: Then do this
slides.title: Check the policy dates yourself before the agent sends anything.
slides.body: "I think it renewed" is not a date.

slides.label: If it actually lapsed
slides.title: "Our renewal is in process. We'll start the day the new certificate is issued."
slides.body: Sending the crew in anyway is the expensive version of this story.

slides.label: Then, tonight
slides.title: Write down when your liability, workers' comp and license renew.
slides.body: All three. In one place. Not the truck visor.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: For the next job where the gate code works but your paperwork doesn't.
